description: A migrator resource: a service.json with appType migrator is registered with tdk resource, and tdk status lists it as a migrator (openspec task 3.6, #1290). M1 and M2 start no stack. Routed health does not apply: a migrator serves no HTTP route. M3 proves the order on a live stack (#531): tdk up starts Postgres, runs the Prisma migrator to completion, then starts the API.
